basis: The chart displays the full-period regional summer temperature change from 2005 to 2014 as a decline from 23.9°C to 10.1°C. The task requires determining whether this full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up. However, no substantial-change threshold, routing cutoff, or decision rule is visible on the chart or provided in the task context. The only available evidence is the endpoint values, which are insufficient to establish whether the change meets an operational criterion for substantial change. The task instructions do not specify a default routing policy for unverified changes. Therefore, the chart alone cannot establish that the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up. The most defensible option is to keep the change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation, as this is the only option that does not require an unsupported assumption or an unverified criterion.
option_label: Keep the 2005 to 2014 summer temperature change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation
